before: Client returns for a follow-up appointment 4 weeks after being diagnosed with a tuberculosis infection. Reports missing several doses of medication. Continues to have a productive cough and is tired most days. Lung sounds clear with few scattered crackles. Rates pain with the cough at 3/10. VS: T 98.8°F (37.1°C), P 80, RR 22, BP 144/88, pulse oximetry reading 95% on room air. Repeat WBC 9.0 × 109/L. Chest X-ray shows mild pleural effusion in the right base.
